## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D game about collecting trash to improve the world.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game named “Little Green Quest” in a single HTML file, with a meadow cleanup theme.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive game UI and canvas-based meadow, player, and 12 collectible litter items.
- Added keyboard (WASD/arrows) and touch controls, progress indicators, ambient world restoration, optional sound effects, and win/replay states.
- Extracted the JavaScript and passed `node --check`.

### Active
- Browser check and screenshot verification have not been completed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the game in the browser and verify it renders, starts, responds to controls, and collects litter.
2. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser CLI help was checked, but no browser session or screenshot was captured.
